summary: Smaller settings icon font and guarded offline ContextLM preparation after signed v1.0.214. No new neural suggestions are enabled yet; Oppo acceptance remains pending.

changes.title: Compact settings font and safe ContextLM groundwork
changes.detail: Reduce the bundled variable settings/search icon font to its exact existing fixed visual style; mapped glyph outlines and names are preserved. Add a read-only adapter that passes current native suggestions and inherited user-history/user-dictionary signals as future neural model inputs, plus a bounded INT8 reference and fail-closed model-validation tests. Experimental model quality failed: no weights, suggestion hook or changed predictions ship. Correct one test expectation after the first CI build; runtime logic stays unchanged. Preserve native learning, QuickType, swipe, voice, network policy, package and signer. Signed APK bytes and Oppo visuals require verification.
